subject: Vendor onboarding: Panama tax ID + e-invoice setup for PO routing
messages:
From: Ana Gomez <ana.gomez@grupoandes.com>
To: connor.obrien@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-28T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding: Panama tax ID and e-invoice details

Hi Connor / Lauren,

Thanks for the runbook — happy to get Grupo Andes set up. Two quick items from our side for PO activation and electronic invoicing in Panama:

1) Tax ID: our local RUC (Registro Unico de Contribuyentes) is 8-12345-6. We've attached a signed supplement (PA_TaxID_Supplement.pdf) and our PAN ID (scanned).

2) E-invoice platform: Panama uses "Factura Electronica" via the DGI portal. We can enroll Grupo Andes's billing entity but the portal requires a specific point-of-sale code and the seller tax regime. I've exported a short setup PDF with the fields your AP team will need (FacturaElectronica-setup-instructions.pdf).

Questions for you:
- Do you need a notarized fiscal rep letter or will the PDF supplement suffice for PO activation?
- For PO routing, should we tag invoices to a single Redwood entity or split by country? We typically invoice to the entity specified on the PO (we can map to your U.S. payables entity if required).

I've cc'd vendor-ops@grupoandes.com for any follow-ups.

Best,
Ana Gomez
Vendor Operations
Grupo Andes S.A.
Attachment: PA_TaxID_Supplement.pdf (PDF)
Attachment: FacturaElectronica-setup-instructions.pdf (PDF)

From: connor.obrien@redwood.com <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Ana Gomez <ana.gomez@grupoandes.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-29T11:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: Panama tax ID and e-invoice details

Ana — thanks, this is helpful. A couple quick internal checks while we move to activate the vendor: 

- Internal ask for finance: Ben, can your team confirm whether the PA_TaxID_Supplement PDF plus the scanned RUC is sufficient for our AP KYC and tax evidence? If Finance requires notarized paperwork for Panama we should flag the timeline for the customer.

- PO routing: Lauren — we need to decide if we create a single global supplier record (entity: REDWOOD INC US) or a country-specific supplier entity for Panama. If we choose country-specific, AP will need the entity tax mapping and a billing code.

Action items:
- Ana: if notarized letter is available, please include it; otherwise the supplement is fine for now and we'll note the requirement in the vendor record.
- Ben: please advise on withholding / tax treaty expectations for Panama services (is there a required withholding on service invoices?).

Connor
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: ben.carter@redwood.com <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: connor.obrien@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-01T08:22:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: Panama tax ID and e-invoice details

Connor / Lauren — I reviewed the attachments. Notes from Finance: 

- The PA_TaxID_Supplement.pdf plus the scanned RUC looks acceptable for our vendor tax evidence record. Panama doesn't require W-8-style forms, but we do need a local tax residency confirmation for treaty purposes. The attached file GrupoAndes_W9_equivalent_Panama.pdf is their residency attestation — please add to the vendor file.

- Withholding: for cross-border services between US and Panama, withholding varies by service type. For standard SaaS/consulting it's typically 0% under the current bilateral practices, but we should confirm any local withholding if payments are routed to a Panama bank account. Recommend we:
  * Start with 0% withholding and route invoices to Redwood US entity for the initial PO.
  * If the vendor requests local banking, we do a withholding re-check and may require tax agent clearance.

- PO mapping: suggest single supplier record (REDWOOD INC US) for now and add a tax_notes field: "Panama RUC 8-12345-6; e-invoice via DGI; residency attest provided". If business needs evolve, we can split later.

I'll attach the PDF I reviewed.

Ben Carter
Finance — AP Controls
Redwood Inference
Attachment: GrupoAndes_W9_equivalent_Panama.pdf (PDF)

Ana — great, thanks for the quick turn. We're ready to proceed with the following plan:

1) Redwood will create a vendor record under REDWOOD INC US and route initial POs/invoices to our US payables account (this avoids immediate local withholding questions).
2) Grupo Andes should enroll the billing entity in the DGI Factura Electronica portal and share the point-of-sale code when available; we'll store it on the vendor record for invoice validation.
3) Please upload the notarized residency attestation if/when you have it — Ben confirmed the current attestation is acceptable to start.

Next steps:
- Ana: please upload FacturaElectronica point-of-sale code or confirm enrollment by EOD next week.
- Lauren: I'll need the supplier record created in Coupa (or our vendor master) with tax_notes set to the text Ben recommended. If you can send me the Coupa vendor URL I will validate fields.

Thanks everyone — tagging the vendor-ops mailbox to keep things in the supplier queue.

Connor O'Brien
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
